title: R6B reference case benchmark-options-5-8-9-10: the worked values of option 5 (ground-floor shops with residences above), option 8 (two buildings on one lot / a divided lot - both meanings) and options 9-10 (shared housing; parking and the transit zone) for the benchmark lot (215-16 Northern Boulevard, lot 70 of block 7334, R6B + C2-2, corner), built from two sealed readings per option family plus the independent comparer; a value recorded ONLY where both readings agree on the same value and the same basis AND every cited section is captured in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1 (the 20 captured by M3-T010 plus the earlier captures); every disagreement, unresolved basis, eligibility, the owner's open meaning questions N1 (option 8) and N2 (option 10) and every missing fact stays NOT KNOWN; options 4 and 11 named as owed; NO rule file, engine, result, capture, register entry, law-library edit or human verdict
objective: Add one new R6B reference case, benchmark-options-5-8-9-10, built from six sealed readings (two per family: option 5 = provenance -26/-27; option 8 = -28/-29; options 9-10 = -30/-31) and the SAME independent comparer already saved at provenance -25 (M5-T184; it covers options 2-10), the six new files saved unchanged below a short truthful header. Record a value or figure on the benchmark lot (recorded lot area 10,075 sq ft, administrative_record; GIS 10,387.99 display-only, never mixed) ONLY where (a) both family readings give it on the same value and the same basis, confirmed by the comparer, AND (b) every cited section is captured in docs/research/zr-snapshots/v1. Rows grouped by option prefix (opt5-*, opt8a-*/opt8b-*/opt8-*, opt910-*/opt10-*) plus shared rows (both-readers-did-not-have, real-lot-missing-facts, options-out-of-scope). Settled value rows include: opt5 commercial FAR 2.00 / 20,150 (2.00 x 10,075, 33-121 plural tables -> quote-only), residential FAR 2.00/2.40 (23-22), combined greatest-single-use cap 2.00 / 20,150 (35-31; 24,180 if residential qualifies), DU 29 baseline when commercial=0 (23-52), heights 30/45/55 (65 qual) (23-432), setback 10 wide/15 narrow (23-433), front yard none (34-231), side yard none/>=5 ft (23-335), retail UG VI (32-161, eligibility caveat); opt8 meaning A FA 20,150 shared / 29 units shared / no gain (23-22, 23-52), min distance 40 ft between unconnected buildings <125 ft (23-371), meaning B FA 10,075 per half / 20,150 total / no gain (23-22), 15 units per half (23-52), heights 30/45/55 (23-432), subdivision a recorded legal act (12-10 zoning-lot), each half about 5,037.5 sq ft and about 50 ft wide (both readings); opt9-10 residential FAR 2.00 / 20,150 (23-22, rooming units residential), 680 factor does NOT apply to rooming units and no ZR unit ceiling (23-51, draft), heights 30/45/55 (23-432), transit zone Outer (recorded dataset value; 12-10 Transit Zone Outer; 25-241 checked, does not reach Queens CD 11), parking 0 for rooming units (25-221), standard-DU parking cross-check 25%/waived <=15 (25-222 Col C), bicycle rule 1 per 2 DU-equiv waived <=10 (25-80/25-811), loading none (36-62), conversion rooming->dwelling (54-311). Rows that stay NOT KNOWN: opt5 storey limit (32-421 now captured but Reader B left it not_known pending capture; one-reading only), opt5 commercial rear yard (both readers not_known; 33-26/33-301 captured; the 33-301 corner-waiver condition named in prose), opt5 lot coverage whole-lot, opt5 overlay mapped line (76-131 uncaptured), opt5 select-commercial-overlay status (both readers not_known; the 12-10 term now captured, noted in prose), opt5 street-wall final line; opt8 B aggregate dwelling units (arithmetic 30 vs 29 = +1 shown in the reason, lawfulness unresolved by both readings - a labelled draft), opt8 B coverage-by-half and interior-half rear yard (geometry/lot-line kinds), opt8 A windows/courts (23-372, 23-35/351/352/353 captured but design inputs), opt8 which-meaning (owner question N1), opt8 B whether the minimum lot area and width of 23-12 bind the halves (one reading only affirms 'not binding'; the other left it not known; the 23-12 thresholds are named in prose); opt9-10 rooming-vs-dwelling classification, opt10 distinct meaning (owner question N2), opt9-10 shared-housing framework not enacted; and the shared real-lot-missing-facts. Every quantity names exactly one of the nine measurement bases; no figure mixes bases; no value comes from a program run; nothing is labelled complies/buildable/optimal/feasible; agreement of two AI readings is not proof. Wire the case in with a new step-P10 module behind ONE thin entry into check.py and recompute the three cross-case digests a new case moves (p7 PRIOR_ROWS_DIGEST, p8 OTHER_CASES_DIGEST, p9 PRIOR_CASES_DIGEST) plus the literal CASE_IDS tuple, CASE_IDS/REQUIRED_BASE_IDS in lib and the README.
business_reason: D-094 R007/R075/R084: the full feasibility report owes worked results for all eleven options; this records options 5, 8, 9 and 10, source-backed and independently agreed, as the single source the report/comparison and any later engine take their expected values from (never from program output), and names options 4 and 11 as owed. The sections options 5/8/9-10 rest on were captured by M3-T010; this task is the sibling of M5-T184 (options 2/3/6/7).

risks: RISK 1 (thin wiring, mandatory): r6b_reference_cases_check.py is at 594 lines; the 600-line guard fails any .py >= 600. The step-P10 wiring must add only ~3 lines to check.py (1 import + 1 call to step_p10.case_errors in validate_case + 1 call to step_p10.reading_digest_errors in provenance_errors) -> ~597, under 600 but tight. ALL per-row/per-case guards live behind ONE step_p10.case_errors(case_id,data) and all reading-digest guards behind ONE entry; do NOT name it provenance_errors (check.py already has one) - use reading_digest_errors wrapped by step_p10. step_p10 itself < 600.

RISK 2 (plural 'tables' key): 33-121 (commercial FAR), 23-12 (min lot area/width) and 23-371 carry their numbers under the plural 'tables' key; the checker's table_assertion reads singular 'table' (None) and would fail 'has no table'. Record 33-121 = 2.00, 23-12 = 2,375/25 & 1,700/18 (recorded only as 'not binding'), 23-371 = 40 ft as arithmetic operands / quote-only + a verbatim quote, table_assertion:null; a reviewer eyeballs the numbers against each snapshot's 'tables'. 23-22 and 23-432 carry singular 'table' -> table_assertion works. 35-31, 25-221, 23-51, 32-161, 34-231, 23-335, 54-311 are prose-only -> quote-only.

RISK 3 (one case, three reading pairs + shared comparer): the generic CASE_READINGS forces one tuple per row, so the case is NOT registered there; check.py both_readings_errors no-ops for it and step_p10 enforces the pair per row prefix (opt5 -26/-27, opt8 -28/-29, opt9-10 -30/-31, shared -25). A negative test MUST prove a one-reading / wrong-pair row is refused.

RISK 4 (comparer is an adjudicator, not a value source): record only where both family readings agree on the same value and basis; -25 only confirms agreement and resolves reader-vs-reader disputes (it resolved the Appendix-F state, the 24-11/33-121 plural-tables misread, the option-8 min-lot-area section 23-12, and the 23-51 rooming-unit carve-out). Keep opt5 storey-limit, opt5 commercial rear yard, opt8 B aggregate DU and opt10 meaning NOT KNOWN; never import a single-reader number.

RISK 5 (capture-now-but-reader-hedged - the plan's interpretive policy): where BOTH sealed readings affirmed the SAME value and the only divergence was that one marked it uncaptured (now captured by M3-T010), RECORD (opt9-10 23-51 no-680; opt8-A 23-371 40 ft; opt8-B 23-12 min-not-binding). Where ONE sealed reading left the item state=not_known pending capture (opt5 storey-limit 32-421), the capture existing does NOT meet the two-reading rule -> stays NOT KNOWN; a later re-read task can promote it. The producer must apply this consistently and the reviewers must confirm the policy against each row's two source files.

RISK 6 (provenance header honesty): the six reading files end END-OF-REPORT but lack 'sealed folder' and a hard-rule marker. The producer prepends a truthful header to -26..-31 supplying the literal phrase 'sealed folder' and a distinct marker; per the readings several readers read official ZR pages live, so the header states the method truthfully and must NOT claim 'no outside access'. Digests are computed on the saved file AFTER the header. The comparer -25 (shared with M5-T184) is referenced unchanged - it is FORBIDDEN to edit (its header/digest are frozen by M5-T184).

RISK 7 (uncaptured sections convention): zero not_captured citations; 76-131, 33-27/28/30, 23-154, 74-902/903, 22-131..135, 77-xx, Appendix I and MDL/HMC are named only in the prose of not-known / both-readers-did-not-have rows, never as a value basis or a formal citation.

RISK 8 (capture-dependency + shared-file ordering): the case cites the 20 M3-T010 captures (content_digest pinned) and shares README.md, lib.py, check.py, render.py, test_r6b_reference_cases.py and the p7/p8/p9 tests with M5-T184. Both M3-T010 and M5-T184 are 'claimed' not accepted; this task must be contracted ONLY after BOTH are accepted (frozen digests / stable base). See the order note.
RISK 9 (sole reference-case task in flight): must be the only open reference-case task while open; it integrates after M5-T184 and M3-T010 and before any further reference-case task.
